game.title: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous
game.blurb: Party-based fantasy RPG of a crusade against the demons of the Worldwound, with mythic paths, from Owlcat Games, released 2021-09-02. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genre: RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: From the fall of Kenabres to Drezen, the Worldwound, the Abyss and the end of the tale. Spoiler-guarded; most hidden achievements sit here.

chapters.title: Mythic Paths
chapters.summary: Choosing and completing a mythic path, and using mythic powers in dialogue.

chapters.title: The Crusade
chapters.summary: Crusade stats, armies and battles, and retaking Drezen quickly.

chapters.title: Companions and Side Quests
chapters.summary: Romance, side mysteries, the Next-Door Theater, the toad and other optional deeds.

chapters.title: Difficulty, Optional Bosses and Feats
chapters.summary: Optional bosses on Core difficulty, Unfair and Last Azlanti runs, and feats of crafting, charging and dispelling.

chapters.title: Sarkoris and Ulbrig
chapters.summary: A separate set of achievements about Ulbrig, the griffons, Gundrun and the forests of Sarkoris.

chapters.title: The Shadow World
chapters.summary: A separate set about the Shadow World, its patrols and notes, and the greatest feats of Sendri, Rekarth and Penta.

chapters.title: The Shards and Sithhud
chapters.summary: A separate set about hidden shards, the Caretaker, the beer elemental and Sithhud.

chapters.title: The Kenabres Festival and the Arena
chapters.summary: A separate set about the Kenabres festival, Razmir and the Echo of Fury arena.

collectibles.name: Sadistic Game Design

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for this game (API returned missing for "Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous"). Fandom: pathfinderwrathoftherighteous.fandom.com, pathfinderwotr.fandom.com and owlcat.fandom.com returned HTTP 404; pathfinder.fandom.com and pathfinder-wrath-of-the-righteous.fandom.com answer the API but have no page under this title, so Fandom is unverified. The Steam store list names app 1184370 "Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Enhanced Edition"; the schema has no app name. 61 of 153 Steam achievements are hidden; most sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder, though many are probably side deeds. Achievements 111 to 153 form separate sets about places and people not found in the base-game achievements (Sarkoris and Ulbrig, the Shadow World, shards and Sithhud, the Kenabres festival and the Echo of Fury arena); they may be add-on content, but nothing in the data names any add-on, so the chapters are named from achievement text. Hidden "A Shard In the Woods", "Cold Snap" (between the Sithhud achievements in the schema) and "Tailed!" (among the festival ones) were placed by name and schema position, a judgement call; hidden 122 to 125 ("A Waste Of Good Suffering", "Certified Adventurers", "Unfair Challenge") stay in the main story. RAWG lists a playtime of only 10 hours, which looks very low for this game.
